statement: Pi validates tool arguments, offers before- and after-tool interception points, and executes a batch sequentially or in parallel according to the configured strategy and individual tool constraints.

display_text.zh-CN: Pi 会校验工具参数，提供 before/after tool 拦截点，并根据全局策略和单个工具约束，以串行或并行方式执行一批 tool calls。
display_text.en: Pi validates tool arguments, offers before- and after-tool interception points, and executes a batch sequentially or in parallel according to the configured strategy and individual tool constraints.

notes: No throughput or race-safety conclusion is inferred from the availability of parallel dispatch.
